text:
elaine: Quick thread for NovaLite embed bring-up. Float32 recall@10=0.864 on holdout-10k. Initial int6-PQ naive -> 0.773, int8 ~0.851. Uploaded summary plot: https://internal.s3/nova/lite/3776549876/summary.png
mike: Did you normalize + OPQ? Those usually recover a lot for low-bit PQ.
elaine: Ran normalize -> OPQ(32) -> PQ(m=8) and recall@10 -> 0.836. Silhouette (k=150) improved 0.29 -> 0.37. CLI used below:

```
./r_eval --model nova-lite-v0 \
       --pooling mean --normalize true \
       --quant int6 --pq-m 8 --opq 32 \
       --holdout holdout-10k.jsonl \
       --metrics recall@1,5,10,silhouette
```

hana: Short-query cohort still bad?
elaine: Yes short (<=6 tokens) float32 0.80 -> int6+OPQ 0.73. Multilang tiny drop. eval-bot flagged short_queries delta -0.07 (needs-triage).
mike: Two options: concat-last2 + PCA reduce, or retrain OPQ on short-query shard. Which is cheaper?
elaine: Concat-last2+PCA(512)+PQ gave overall 0.847 and short 0.78 but index size +15%. Retraining OPQ on short shard looks promising; queued it overnight.
hana: Suggest default onboard with int8+OPQ, and int6 only for experimental routes with silhouette >=0.36 gate. Add cohort checks in PR.
elaine: Will add config + cohort CSV in PR. Scheduling fuzzcheck job nb-3776549876. ETA ~8h. Thanks.
